payload.text: `DEVBIN_FLEET_FROZEN` MATCHES AN ESTATE'S LABEL, its path below the run's roots (0182), so a basename freezes only an estate at a root's top level. A name that labels no estate this run could sweep prints `matches none`, and --apply refuses while one is declared. Before any --apply: run the plan, copy each frozen name from its estate's row, and read the FROZEN rows, the summary's frozen count and that no `matches none` line prints.
